country_inn_coverage_addendum.question: Does Firecrawl extend Choice coverage, or only match it? Three Country Inn & Suites by Radisson properties returned ACCESS_DENIED under the Bright Data Web Unlocker in the Milwaukee run and have no baseline. They were tested for ACQUISITION only.
country_inn_coverage_addendum.result: Firecrawl failed all three with SCRAPE_ALL_ENGINES_FAILED -- the same properties, the same wall. The Country Inn & Suites Germantown success in the main sample is NOT a coverage gain: Bright Data acquires that property too. Firecrawl MATCHES Choice coverage; it does not extend it.
